bai: Bai 22 - Bao cao dong Dashboard (PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer)
cong_thuc: =MIN(IF(vung>0,vung)) + Ctrl+Shift+Enter: doanh thu nho nhat nhung >0, loai thang nghi (=0).
Ctrl+T (Insert > Table, tick My table has headers): doi vung du lieu thanh Table de tu mo rong khi them dong.
Insert > PivotTable tu Table 'Du lieu': chon New Worksheet, keo Nam/Thang vao Rows, Doanh thu vao Values.
Design > Report Layout > Show in Tabular Form: hien PivotTable dang bang de doc.
Insert > PivotChart (Column/Line/Pie): ve doanh thu theo nam-thang; doi kieu chart tuy muc dich.
Insert > Slicer (Nam, Thang, Khu vuc, Nha phan phoi): tao 4 nut loc dieu khien dashboard.
Right-click Slicer > Report Connections: tick het cac PivotTable de 1 slicer dieu khien moi bieu do.
Value Filter > Top 10 (doi 10 thanh 3): loc Top 3 san pham doanh thu cao nhat; doi Bottom cho 3 san pham te nhat.
Right-click truc > Format Axis > Categories in reverse order: dao truc de Top 1 len tren cung.
Right-click cot > Add Data Labels / Format Data Labels (Category Name + Value): hien ten + so tien tren bieu do.
Format Data Series > Border Solid line + Width 2-3pt: bo vien cot tron dep; Line chart chon Smooth line.
Number format #,##0: tach hang nghin cho nhan gia tri (vi du 333333 -> 333,333).
Change Chart Type (Column/Line/Pie) + Chart Elements (+): doi kieu bieu do, them Chart Title/Legend/Data Labels; keo resize, can bo cuc Dashboard.
PivotTable Analyze > Refresh + Slicer Multi-select/Clear Filter: nap du lieu moi tu Table (~5000 dong), chon nhieu muc, xoa loc de test dong bo.
thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: chon 1 o bat ky trong vung du lieu, nhan Ctrl+T (tick headers), doi ten Table thanh 'Du lieu'.
Buoc 2: Insert > PivotTable tu Table, chon New Worksheet; keo Nam/Thang vao Rows, Doanh thu vao Values.
Buoc 3: dinh dang PivotTable (Tabular, bo Grand Total/Subtotal thua), Insert > PivotChart dau tien.
Buoc 4: copy PivotChart thanh cac ban sao cho: Top 3, Bottom 3, % theo Khu vuc, % theo Nha phan phoi.
Buoc 5: moi chart: doi loai (Column/Line/Pie), loc Top/Bottom, sap xep, them Data Labels, dinh dang so.
Buoc 6: tao sheet Dashboard moi, copy cac chart ve, sap xep bo cuc; chen Slicer Nam/Thang/Khu vuc/NPP.
Buoc 7: voi moi Slicer: Right-click > Report Connections > tick TAT CA PivotTable de loc dong bo.
Buoc 8: an cac sheet trung gian (chon nhieu sheet > Hide), chi giu Dashboard; test loc 2020, multi-select.

cau_hoi.cau: Vi sao phai doi vung du lieu thanh Table truoc khi lam dashboard?
cau_hoi.A: De du lieu tu mo rong khi them dong moi
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Table tu dong nap dong moi vao PivotTable.

cau_hoi.cau: Phim tat tao Table la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+T mo hop Create Table, hoac Insert > Table.

cau_hoi.cau: Khi tao Table can tick tuy chon nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bao Excel dong dau la tieu de, khong tinh thanh du lieu.

cau_hoi.cau: PivotTable duoc tao tu nguon nao trong bai?
cau_hoi.A: Vung thuong A1:Z100
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dat ten Table roi chon no lam nguon PivotTable.

cau_hoi.cau: Nen dat PivotTable moi o dau?
cau_hoi.A: New Worksheet
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Moi PivotTable mot sheet rieng cho gon, sau copy ve Dashboard.

cau_hoi.cau: Keo truong Nam/Thang vao khu vuc nao cua PivotTable?
cau_hoi.A: Values
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Rows de liet ke theo nam thang, Doanh thu keo vao Values.

cau_hoi.cau: Report Layout Tabular Form co tac dung?
cau_hoi.A: Xoa du lieu
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Hien PivotTable dang bang de doc
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dang Tabular tach cot ro rang hon Compact.

cau_hoi.cau: Grand Total/Subtotal thua thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.A: De nguyen
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Right-click > remove hoac Design > tat khi khong can.

cau_hoi.cau: De ve bieu do tu PivotTable dung lenh nao?
cau_hoi.A: Insert > PivotChart
cau_hoi.giai_thich: PivotChart tu dong gan voi PivotTable nguon.

cau_hoi.cau: Slicer trong dashboard dung de lam gi?
cau_hoi.A: Trang tri
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bam slicer de loc dong loat cac bieu do.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen Slicer bang cach nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon 4 truong Nam, Thang, Khu vuc, Nha phan phoi.

cau_hoi.cau: Lam sao 1 Slicer loc duoc TAT CA bieu do?
cau_hoi.A: Khong the
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Right-click Slicer > Report Connections > tick het
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Report Connections noi slicer toi moi PivotTable.

cau_hoi.cau: Neu quen tick 1 PivotTable trong Report Connections thi?
cau_hoi.A: Bieu do do khong loc theo, lech so lieu
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Phai tick het de dong bo toan dashboard.

cau_hoi.cau: De xem chi nam 2020 thi bam gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Slicer loc 1 gia tri; muon nhieu nam bat Multi-select.

cau_hoi.cau: Nut Multi-select (dau 3 o) tren slicer de?
cau_hoi.A: Xoa
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick nhieu nam/thang de so sanh.

cau_hoi.cau: Loc Top 3 san pham dung chuc nang nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Value Filter > Top 10 roi doi 10 thanh 3
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Row Labels > Value Filters > Top 10 > Top 3 by Sum of Doanh thu.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon xem 3 san pham TE nhat thi chon?
cau_hoi.A: Bottom
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Top 10 > chon Bottom, nhap 3.

cau_hoi.cau: Sau khi sort, cot Top 1 lai nam duoi cung thi sua sao?
cau_hoi.A: Ke no
cau_hoi.B: Format Axis > tick Categories in reverse order
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dao nguoc truc de gia tri lon len tren.

cau_hoi.cau: Hien so tien tren moi cot bieu do dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Right-click series > Add Data Labels.

cau_hoi.cau: Hien ca ten mien + doanh thu tren Pie dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Format Data Labels > tick Category Name + Value
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick ca ten va gia tri trong Format Data Labels.

cau_hoi.cau: Dinh dang 333333 thanh 333,333 dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Format Data Labels > Number > Custom #,##0.

cau_hoi.cau: Duong Line thang goc canh muon mem mai thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Format Data Series > tick Smoothed line.

cau_hoi.cau: Vien cot bieu do mau cam day 3pt chinh o dau?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Format Data Series > Border > Solid line, Width 3pt
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon mau + do rong vien trong Border.

cau_hoi.cau: Copy nhanh 1 PivotChart sang sheet moi bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giu Ctrl keo tab de nhan ban sheet chart.

cau_hoi.cau: Nhan ban 1 chart trong cung sheet bang?
cau_hoi.A: Giu Ctrl + keo chart
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+drag de copy chart roi doi nguon du lieu.

cau_hoi.cau: Tu chart Khu vuc muon thanh chart Nha phan phoi thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: Bo Khu vuc khoi Legend, keo Nha phan phoi vao
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Doi truong Legend/Axis trong PivotChart Fields.

cau_hoi.cau: Bieu do tron % theo Khu vuc ban dau la chart gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Copy tu chart Top 3 roi doi kieu Pie
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tan dung chart cu: copy roi doi loai + truong du lieu.

cau_hoi.cau: Ten cac chart (Top 3, Bottom 3...) dat o dau?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Sua Chart Title thanh Doanh thu Top 3...

cau_hoi.cau: Them chu thich mau (Legend) bang?
cau_hoi.A: Chart Elements (+) > Legend
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick Legend roi keo vi tri phu hop.

cau_hoi.cau: Dam bao 2020 cac chart deu thay doi thi kiem tra gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Slicer phai noi toi moi PivotTable chart.

cau_hoi.cau: An cac sheet phu chi giu Dashboard bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giu Shift chon sheet roi Hide, dashboard sach.

cau_hoi.cau: Nguon du lieu gan 5000 dong thi luu y gi?
cau_hoi.A: Cu ve tay
cau_hoi.B: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Dung Table + Pivot de tu dong, tranh cong thuc nang
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Pivot xu ly hang nghin dong nhanh, gon.

cau_hoi.cau: =MIN(IF(vung>0,vung)) + CSE o dau bai la?
cau_hoi.A: Dap an bai tap bai 21 (min > 0)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bo qua o 0 cua thang nghi, lay min that.

cau_hoi.cau: Hoan thanh dashboard can test lai dieu gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: Bam tung slicer xem moi chart nhay dung
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Kiem tra 2020, tung thang, khu vuc, NPP deu dong bo.

cau_hoi.cau: Muc dich cuoi cua dashboard trong bai?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Theo doi doanh thu theo nam/thang, top/bottom SP, ty trong vung/NPP
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Mot man hinh thay moi goc do kinh doanh.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon them % ben canh so tien tren chart thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick Percentage de hien ty trong them.

cau_hoi.cau: Kich thuoc chart qua to/nho thi?
cau_hoi.A: Keo goc resize cho vua bo cuc
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Keo goc + sap xep lai dashboard cho can doi.

cau_hoi.cau: Khi them du lieu thang moi, Pivot cap nhat bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nguon Table tu mo rong, Refresh de nap.

cau_hoi.cau: File dashboard gui sep nen o dinh dang nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giu file song de sep tu bam slicer loc.

cau_hoi.cau: Truoc khi gui dashboard cho sep can lam gi cuoi cung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Test tung slicer + Refresh + an sheet phu, luu file
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Kiem tra dong bo roi moi gui.
